description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useCloudZeroExport' that facilitates exporting data to CloudZero via a POST request. It includes a helper function 'performCloudZeroExport' for performing the API call and manages response handling, including error scenarios.

methods.name: performCloudZeroExport
methods.description: Performs the actual fetch request to export data from CloudZero, handling response and errors.
